# Teamulate

> Teamulate is an autonomous AI marketing department for B2B companies. The department runs the work. Strategos is Head of Marketing. Chris Momchilov is the founder above Teamulate.

A full marketing department. Without building one. Eleven named seats (Strategos as Head; Scout, Wordsmith, Seeker, GrowthTrack, Pixel, Flow, Socialite, Nexus as execution; Metric and Guardian as independent assurance), a 60-workflow eligible library with plan activation caps (8 / 20 / 35), and one dashboard. Pricing in CAD: Core C$7,500 setup + C$5,000/mo; Growth C$12,500 + C$7,500/mo; Scale C$20,000 + from C$12,000/mo.

- [How It Works](https://teamulate.ca/how-it-works/): the end-to-end operating model
- [The 11-Agent Team](https://teamulate.ca/team/): every seat, its boundaries and outputs
- [Workflow Library](https://teamulate.ca/workflows/): 60 eligible workflows; plans activate 8, 20 or 35
- [Dashboard](https://teamulate.ca/dashboard/): the proof and control surface
- [Pricing](https://teamulate.ca/pricing/): Core, Growth and Scale in CAD
- [Security & Governance](https://teamulate.ca/security-governance/): approvals, permissions and audit
